skip_reason: Services not running — static mode only

escalations.title: Arbitrary Code Execution in protobufjs (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.description: Arbitrary code execution via crafted .proto files. Prototype pollution gadget chains. Complete system compromise via network-accessible gRPC APIs.
escalations.fix: cd platform/orchestrator && npm update protobufjs  # target ≥7.7.0

escalations.title: IP Spoofing / Auth Bypass via proxy-addr (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.description: Attackers spoof trusted IP addresses via IPv4-mapped IPv6 notation. Bypasses IP-based access control. CWE-290, CWE-348, CWE-697.
escalations.fix: cd Source/Backend && npm update express; cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express

escalations.title: Prototype Pollution → RCE in tinypool (via vitest)
escalations.description: Prototype pollution gadget in worker options allows runtime code execution. Affects test runners and can leak to build pipeline. Arbitrary code execution during build/test phase.

escalations.title: Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read in @vitest/mocker
escalations.description: Allows reading arbitrary files during test execution via malicious mock redirects. Path traversal via mock redirect targets. Could leak .env, secrets, /etc/passwd during CI runs.

p2_findings.title: Specification Identity Crisis — main spec 0% implemented
p2_findings.description: dev-workflow-platform.md defines 69 FRs for a FeatureRequest/BugReport platform. The actual codebase implements a Self-Judging Workflow Engine whose spec lives in Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md. 0 of 69 primary-spec FRs are implemented. CLAUDE.md 'Specs are source of truth' rule is violated.
p2_findings.recommendation: Archive dev-workflow-platform.md to Specifications/archived/ and write a spec describing the workflow engine that was actually built — OR formally mark in-scope vs out-of-scope sections.

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-search endpoint not wired into app.ts
p2_findings.description: GET /api/search?q= is not registered in app.ts. Test file explicitly documents this will fail. DependencyPicker typeahead calls this endpoint.
p2_findings.recommendation: Implement and register /api/search route in app.ts per FR-dependency-search spec.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry / W3C traceparent not implemented
p2_findings.description: CLAUDE.md requires OTel distributed tracing with W3C traceparent propagation. @opentelemetry/api is a transitive dep only; zero spans/traces/traceparent reads exist in Source/Backend/src/.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node, auto-instrumentation, and a src/tracing.ts bootstrap.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer silently ignores 69 primary-spec FRs — reports false PASSED
p2_findings.description: Enforcer auto-selects the most-recently-modified spec file (Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md) and checks only its 13 FRs. 69-FR main spec and 2 unimplemented dependency FRs are silently ignored, producing a false PASSED result.
p2_findings.recommendation: Fix enforcer to check all spec files in the Specifications/ directory, not just the most-recently-modified one.

p2_findings.title: Unbounded Memory Growth in browserslist (DoS)
p2_findings.description: Memory leak in browserslist query cache with no eviction policy → eventual OOM crash.

p2_findings.title: Multiple gRPC DoS + Certificate Bypass in @grpc/grpc-js
p2_findings.description: Malformed requests crash gRPC server; certificate validation bypass (CVSS 7.4).

p2_findings.title: ReDoS in path-to-regexp via express routing
p2_findings.description: Regular Expression DoS via multiple route parameters → request hang.

p2_findings.title: JavaScript Injection via Handlebars @partial-block
p2_findings.description: AST type confusion via @partial-block tampering → arbitrary JS execution during test runs.

p2_findings.title: CRLF Injection in form-data
p2_findings.description: Unescaped multipart field names/filenames allow HTTP header injection attacks.

p2_findings.title: nanoid Infinite Loop CPU DoS
p2_findings.description: Non-secure generators can loop indefinitely with negative/zero size → CPU exhaustion.

p3_findings.title: FR-dependency-seed has no implementation
p3_findings.description: No seed.ts, no Verifies comment, no seed call in app.ts. FR references outdated portal/ path.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable without explanation in DependencyPicker and useWorkItems
p3_findings.description: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed without comment explaining why. Both files modified in last 14 days.

p3_findings.title: 5 frontend components lack tests
p3_findings.description: Layout.tsx, PriorityBadge.tsx, StatusBadge.tsx, TypeBadge.tsx, DebugPortalPage.tsx have no test files. Badge components have conditional rendering paths used on every list page.

p3_findings.title: Brace Expansion DoS in jest/glob dependencies
p3_findings.description: Exponential-time expansion of brace patterns → CPU DoS during test runs.

p3_findings.title: esbuild CORS bypass + baseline-browser-mapping crash
p3_findings.description: esbuild dev server CORS bypass; baseline-browser-mapping DoS crash.
p3_findings.fix: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite esbuild

p3_findings.title: Multiple jest ≤30.2.0 package vulnerabilities
p3_findings.description: jest-message-util logging escape bypass; jest-haste-map file iteration issues; micromatch glob DoS.
